verdict.rationale: DeepSeek documents tool use as a first-class API capability, with a maintained function-calling guide and runnable OpenAI-format examples, and its OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API and Harness preview make it a plausible agent backend. Reliability is contested: one hands-on report found function calling broken on the older DS3 (duplicated calls, hallucinated names and parameters). That report predates the current models, so it is a caveat rather than a dispute. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of parallel tool calls, explicit multi-step/agent-loop guidance, detail on typed schemas or strict mode, and independent evidence that current models call tools faithfully.
